question: Uttar Pradesh govt to transform all municipal corporations into solar cities. Where was the announcement made during the concluding session of a national conference on the National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Gorakhpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Uttar Pradesh govt to transform all municipal corporations into solar cities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Yogi Adityanath**, the **Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh**, announced that all **municipal corporations** in the state will be transformed into **solar cities** as part of the state’s commitment to **clean energy** and **sustainable urban growth**.
 
• The announcement was made during the concluding session of a **three-day workshop and national conference** on the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)** held in **Gorakhpur**.
 
• Uttar Pradesh aims to generate **22,000 Mega Watt** of **clean energy**.
 
• **Ayodhya** has already become Uttar Pradesh’s **first solar city**, generating **6,000 Mega Watt** of renewable energy.
 
• **Bundelkhand** is developing a **green energy corridor** with a capacity of **5,000 Mega Watt**
